A '''chronoscanner''' was a [[Portable scanner/Legends|portable scanner]] used on [[Bardotta/Legends|Bardotta]], an isolated [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Chronoscanners were important to the [[Bardottan/Legends|Bardottans]], in that they were used to identify the chemical composition of an object rapidly and estimating its date of manufacture to within a century. As theft of ancient artifacts was a serious crime on Bardotta, port security used the devices to scan cargo being taken offworld to ensure there was no illegal smuggling.<ref name="NoP" />
